anomalies.description: Following the apparent gunshot, multiple individuals engage in close physical confrontation: the man who fired moves forward aggressively, another person at the bar turns and appears to grapple or strike, and bodies are in contact near the bar counter.

A man on the left side of the frame (visible in f7 and f8) raises a handgun and fires it toward the center of the bar; muzzle flash is not visible but the posture, arm extension, and immediate reaction of others confirm a gunshot.
